parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description:
The ID of the task configuration.

>  You can call the [CreateCycleTask](~~CreateCycleTask~~) operation to query the IDs of task configurations.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The name of the task. Valid values:

*   **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE_SCAN**: virus scan task
*   **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan task
*   **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE_SCAN**: urgent vulnerability scan task

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of the task. Valid values:

*   **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE_SCAN**: virus scan task
*   **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan task
*   **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE_SCAN**: urgent vulnerability scan task

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-cycle-task-list --task-name IMAGE_SCAN --task-type IMAGE_SCAN --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --config-id f93b6ee24cfd0aad44b897ad50510000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
